items.title: [issue-open]: [Request] Mobile-specific default css
items.author: lowlydba
items.content:
First off, thanks for making this! I am actively migrating over to a self-hosted RSS reader from Feedly now thanks to this project.

One of my main use cases is reading LiveBoat on my phone, and I find it really difficult to discern the ui elements on a small screen. I also use grayscale-only mode on my phone frequently (in addition to the `mono` theme), which exacerbates things.

If this doesn't fit your vision, I'm happy to also make this as a third-party template/theme instead too.

I chose *The Skint* for this since they use all caps in their titles, which I think reduces readability further so makes for a good test case.

This is mostly vibed css, so take it as a grain of salt. There is likely a more elegant approach than overriding desktop css, for example.

The biggest parts of this that work well for me are shrinking the title size so there are fewer wrapped lines, adding background containers to delineate between rows, and forcing new lines for the author/link meta so its easier to find.

/* Mobile-oriented overrides, layered on top of index.css. */

@media (max-width: 640px) {

body { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; overflow-x: hidden; }

#app { padding: .5rem; width: 100%; max-width: 100vw; }

/* Feed section header: solid banner so groups are obvious */

#app .feed-title { padding: 0; margin: 20px 0 8px; border-bottom: 0; }

#app .feed-title a {

display: block; max-width: 100%; top: 0; padding: 10px 12px;

border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem;

border-left: 4px solid var(--color-custom);

}

#app .feed-wrapper { padding: 0 0 8px; }

#app ul { padding: 0; }

/* Date label separates day groups */

#app .feed-group-date {

display: block; width: auto; margin: 14px 2px 6px;

font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em;

text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .85;

} #app .feed-item {

line-height: 1.35; margin: 0 0 8px; padding: 12px 14px;

background: rgb(from var(--color-accent) r g b / 22%);

border-left: 3px solid var(--color-accent);

border-radius: 6px; #app .feed-item-link { display: block; }

#app .feed-item-link a { display: inline; padding: 0; }

/* Title: strong, readable; links get an underline cue */

#app .feed-item-link > a:first-child {

font-weight: 700; font-size: .88rem; color: var(--color-text);

text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--color-highlight);

text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 3px; /* Metadata line: small, dim, distinct from title */ #app .feed-item-domain {

display: inline-block; margin: 6px 8px 0 0; font-size: .78rem;

opacity: .7; color: var(--color-highlight); #app .feed-item-domain { margin-left: 0; opacity: .55; }

/* Larger tap targets for expand/comment buttons */

#app .article-button { padding: 0 6px; top: 0; vertical-align: middle; line-height: 1; }

#app .article-button svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; top: 0; }

#app .article-unexpand svg { top: 0; }

/* Expanded description reads as a quoted block */

#app .feed-item-details {

padding: 10px 0 0; margin-top: 10px; opacity: .95;

border-top: 1px solid rgb(from var(--color-text) r g b / 20%); }

#app .feed-item-contents p { margin-bottom: 12px; }

#app .feed-item-contents img, #app .feed-item-contents video { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }

#app .feed-item-contents pre { overflow-x: auto; }

/* Filter bar */

#app .filter-box button, #app #filter-search input { min-height: 40px; }

#app .filter-container { height: auto; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-bottom: 56px; }

#app #filter-search { left: 0; transform: none; bottom: 0; }

}
